title: Lost Carcosa
wikitext:
'''Lost Carcosa''' is an [[Other World]] from the [[Expansion]] [[Dunwich Horror]].  It is the setting of the infamous play, [[The King in Yellow]], and is the domain of the [[Ancient One]] [[Hastur]].
